title: Steady Motion of a Self-Propelled Body in a Viscous Fluid: Dirichlet Boundary Conditions with Nonzero Flux
summary: We study the steady self-propelled motion of a rigid body immersed in an incompressible viscous fluid occupying an exterior domain in $\mathbb{R}^3$. In a body-fixed reference frame, the problem is described by a coupled fluid-rigid body system posed in a fixed exterior domain, where the Navier--Stokes equations are coupled with the unknown translational and angular velocities of the rigid body. The self-propulsion is generated by prescribing a boundary velocity on the body surface.
